Symon is a warder.

== Activities ==
Symon died in the [[Tarmon Gai'don|Last Battle]] on Polov Heights at the [[Field of Merrilor]]. His corpse was seen by [[Gawyn Trakand]] as it was being carried by a trolloc to be eaten. Seeing his body angered Gawyn into beheading the trolloc and risking being found despite his use of the [[Bloodknife|Bloodknives]] ring Ter'Angreal.

== Trivia ==
* Symon is named for Simone Brusso, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
